precedents.explanation: Pending Northern Shield Insurance rule requires a physical address rather than a post office box. DR-072 has a rating reason (garaging location); DR-039 has only an administrative one.
Pending Granite Mutual Insurance rule declines refusal to disclose household drivers. That is risk information; an email address is not.
Pending Lakefield Mutual rule requires telematics consent. Both make a technology requirement a condition of coverage.
